note: The generator injects an `Idempotency-Key` header the caller cannot reach, on every non-GET operation and no GET. The skills lean on that rule to tell a reader that the header's presence proves nothing and only the source of its value does. If the rule moves, the guidance goes wrong in the one direction that costs money — a write that looks deduplicated and is not — so it is asserted rather than trusted.

assertions.claim: Every non-GET operation carries an `Idempotency-Key` header and no GET does; where no parameter feeds it, the value is a generator-injected `Guid.NewGuid()` the caller cannot set.
assertions.defends: dotnet-configuration-resilience - Make the write idempotent at the provider, the injected-header warning
